name: Speakflow Teleprompter
description: Speakflow is the teleprompter your team uses to write, rehearse, and record scripted video together. The Speakflow connector gives agents access to the teleprompter scripts and labels in your workspace. Use it to draft the next internal video, drop it on the teleprompter for whoever is on camera, rewrite last week's script without overwriting a newer edit, and get the URL so they can open it and record.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Speakflow Teleprompter to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Speakflow Teleprompter to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.speakflow.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Speakflow Teleprompter MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Speakflow Teleprompter provides these MCP tools: create_speakflow_script, delete_speakflow_script, get_speakflow_account, get_speakflow_script, list_speakflow_labels, list_speakflow_scripts, and update_speakflow_script.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Speakflow Teleprompter?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Speakflow Teleprompter in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Speakflow Teleprompter MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Speakflow Teleprompter requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Speakflow Teleprompter is developed by Speakflow. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
